name: @tduyng/pi-devos
description: DevOS for Pi. The Pi package for DevOS, a lazy SDD framework for one engineer or a small team: adaptive sizing, a spec-driven pipeline with an approval gate, evidence-based verification. Install with `pi install npm:@tduyng/pi-devos`. Zero dependencies.
